description: Statistical comparison of PXA-domain cavities against size-matched truncation controls and lipid-binding/non-lipid proteins
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy import stats
df=pd.read_csv("cavity_sensitivity.csv")
d6=df[df.psp_min==6].copy()
pxa=d6[d6.set=="PXA module"]; trunc=d6[d6.set=="truncation control"]; intact=d6[d6.set=="intact control"]
ctrl=pd.concat([trunc,intact])

def mw(a,b,lab):
    u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative="greater")
    # rank-biserial effect size
    r=2*u/(len(a)*len(b))-1
    print(f"{lab}: PXA median={np.median(a):.2f} (n={len(a)}) vs control median={np.median(b):.2f} (n={len(b)}), U={u:.0f}, p={p:.4f}, rank-biserial r={r:.2f}")
    return p,r

print("=== PXA modules vs size-matched truncation controls (psp_min=6) ===")
mw(pxa.vol_per_res, trunc.vol_per_res, "cavity volume per residue")
mw(pxa.KD.fillna(-5), trunc.KD.fillna(-5), "cavity-lining mean Kyte-Doolittle")
mw(pxa.hyd_res.fillna(0), trunc.hyd_res.fillna(0), "hydrophobic lining residue fraction")
print("\n=== PXA modules vs ALL controls (truncation + intact) ===")
mw(pxa.vol_per_res, ctrl.vol_per_res, "cavity volume per residue")
mw(pxa.KD.fillna(-5), ctrl.KD.fillna(-5), "cavity-lining mean Kyte-Doolittle")

print("\n=== Nvj3 within the PXA family (z-scores vs the 5 other PXA domains) ===")
others=pxa[~pxa.protein.str.startswith("NVJ3")]
for col in ["top_vol","vol_per_res","KD","hyd_res","apolar","long_axis"]:
    v=float(pxa[pxa.protein.str.startswith("NVJ3")][col].iloc[0]); m=others[col].mean(); s=others[col].std()
    print(f"  {col:12s} Nvj3={v:7.2f}  others mean={m:7.2f} sd={s:5.2f}  z={(v-m)/s:+.2f}")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(15,5))
cols=[("vol_per_res","Top cavity volume per residue (A^3)"),("KD","Cavity-lining mean Kyte-Doolittle"),
      ("hyd_res","Fraction hydrophobic lining residues")]
groups=[("PXA domains",pxa,"#c0392b"),("lipid-binding ctrl",d6[d6.protein.str.contains("SEC14|OSH4|PRY1")],"#2980b9"),
        ("non-lipid ctrl",d6[d6.protein.str.contains("PGK1|TPI1|SNX3")],"#7f8c8d")]
for ax,(c,t) in zip(axes,cols):
    for i,(lab,g,col) in enumerate(groups):
        y=g[c].fillna(0).values; x=np.random.default_rng(0).normal(i,0.07,len(y))
        ax.scatter(x,y,color=col,s=55,alpha=0.85,label=lab if c=="vol_per_res" else None)
        ax.hlines(np.median(y),i-0.25,i+0.25,color=col,lw=2.5)
    nv=float(pxa[pxa.protein.str.startswith("NVJ3")][c].iloc[0])
    ax.scatter([0],[nv],facecolors="none",edgecolors="black",s=260,lw=2)
    ax.annotate("Nvj3",(0,nv),xytext=(10,8),textcoords="offset points",fontsize=10,fontweight="bold")
    ax.set_xticks(range(3)); ax.set_xticklabels([g[0] for g in groups],rotation=12)
    ax.set_title(t,fontsize=10); ax.grid(axis="y",alpha=0.3)
axes[0].legend(fontsize=8)
plt.suptitle("AlphaFold cavity analysis: PXA domains carry a large, strongly apolar cavity (LIGSITE PSP>=6 of 7)")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
